tests.title: accepts only the bare acopy token and refuses every option form with an exact message

plans unchanged counts, packet sections and one frame reservation
returns owned planes byte-equal to a transcription of av_frame_copy, without mutating the input, at any frame split
matches native framecrc bytes across raw formats, channel counts, rates and composed chains

registry invariants including the acopy example

unsupported: any acopy option, including the native-accepted empty 'acopy='
FLAC input (refused before decoding; flacInput not declared)
automatic sample-rate conversion across acopy (rateConversion false)
three-channel AIFF output not compared (pre-existing AIFF muxer mismatch without any filter)

notes: Setup durations: submodule 46s, npm ci 9s, reference:build 185s, baseline static+unit 140s; differential acopy suite ~14s.

formats() is 'all' per spec (af_acopy.c declares no sample formats); apply() memcpys planes when the target equals the input format and otherwise uses convertAudioFrame for the merged neighbour format.
Native accepts 'acopy=' (empty arguments); EdgeFFmpeg refuses it explicitly; scratch probe only.
Three-channel AIFF output differs from native even with no filter or with anull; this is outside acopy's owned files and was not fixed. AIFF comparisons cover 1-2 channels.
No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
